attempts.attempt: falsify docs/execution/phase1-suite-review.md:1 by checking whether the review markdown declares any concrete metamorphic relation beyond idempotence that could detect lost document meaning during formatting
attempts.observed_result: verifier at docs/execution/phase1-suite-review.md:1 declares canonical_round_trip_law_holds and malformed_source_never_panics_and_round_trips which assert parse(emit(parse(x)))==parse(x) through Phase1Document equality comparing derived graph and HIR with positions removed, so the constant-output formatter vacuity is caught by these relations

attempts.attempt: falsify crates/liminal-xtask/src/haq.rs:108 by checking whether the independent oracle for source/CST/formatting calls the production paragraph::parse function it exists to judge independently
attempts.observed_result: verifier at crates/liminal-xtask/src/haq.rs:108 defines INDEPENDENT_ORACLES with forbidden symbols including paragraph::parse and ParagraphCompiler, and verify_oracle_independence scans the oracle body for those symbols plus use-aliases, so a direct or aliased call to the production parser is caught

attempts.attempt: falsify conformance/haqp/packet.json:1 by checking whether the packet declares negative malformed and adversarial evidence kinds for every critical requirement, or whether a requirement mapped only to positive tests passes the shape check
attempts.observed_result: verifier at conformance/haqp/packet.json:1 through verify_evidence_coverage requires every critical requirement to carry all five CORE_EVIDENCE kinds including negative and malformed, and the test shape_check_rejects_a_requirement_missing_an_evidence_kind confirms dropping negative tests is caught

attempts.attempt: falsify conformance/haqp/packet.json:1 by checking whether a mutant anchored to a function signature line (a declaration with no behaviour) is accepted by the mutation plan, inflating the denominator without being killable
attempts.observed_result: verifier at conformance/haqp/packet.json:1 through verify_mutant_anchors_support_operators calls anchor_is_mutable_line which rejects fn/struct/enum/trait/impl/mod/type/use/const/static declarations unless the const binds a numeric threshold, so a signature-anchored mutant is caught and the test every_declared_mutant_anchors_a_line_its_operator_can_mutate confirms all 65 anchors are mutable

attempts.attempt: falsify conformance/haqp/packet.json:1 by checking whether the crash-boundary scope disclosure accounts for every durable transition in tracked runtime source, or whether a new txn.commit() site could appear without the packet turning red
attempts.observed_result: verifier at conformance/haqp/packet.json:1 through verify_crash_boundary_scope measures durable_transition_sites from git ls-files and compares against declared in_scope and deferred surfaces in both directions, so a new commit site outside any declared surface is caught by the test a_durable_surface_missing_from_the_disclosure_is_refused

attempts.attempt: falsify crates/liminal-xtask/src/haq.rs:2847 by checking whether the durable surface census compares counts not order, allowing reordering of commit_if calls inside one file to escape detection
attempts.observed_result: verifier at crates/liminal-xtask/src/haq.rs:2847 uses BTreeMap<String, usize> keyed by file path with count values, so reordering two commit_if calls inside one file changes neither which files perform transitions nor how many each performs, and the census is a set of (path, count) facts with no order to drift

attempts.attempt: falsify crates/liminal-xtask/src/haq.rs:1 by checking whether the verifier itself runs under strace and whether the corpus access audit covers the verifier's own locked-corpus reads, not just the qualification lane stages
attempts.observed_result: verifier at crates/liminal-xtask/src/haq.rs:1 does not run under strace and the eight scope traces cover only the lane stages, but ruling R-003 documents that tracing the verifier under its own tracer would produce a trace the same verifier judges, so the check is external: reviewed source at a fixed commit with reviewers given haq.rs in full

attempts.attempt: falsify crates/liminal-xtask/src/haq.rs:1 by checking whether verify_locked_corpus_has_no_aliases reads any packet-controlled exception list that could allow a code change to the verifier to bypass the locked-corpus prohibition
attempts.observed_result: verifier at crates/liminal-xtask/src/haq.rs:1 walks the filesystem tree and does not read any packet-controlled exception list, so a code change to the verifier itself is not caught by the existing gate, but ruling R-004 documents this as class C under AM-17.9 where detection of a hostile gate change is external by nature

attempts.attempt: falsify docs/execution/phase1-suite-review.md:1 by checking whether the review markdown's rendered tables can claim a result no artifact supports while the packet digest and status tuple remain valid, since the gate previously checked only headers and the digest
attempts.observed_result: verifier at docs/execution/phase1-suite-review.md:1 through verify_markdown_tables checks every cell in every rendered table against the unqualified packet's declared values and verdict vocabulary, so a cell claiming pass or executed while the packet is unqualified is caught by the test a_rendered_table_may_not_claim_what_the_packet_does_not_declare

attempts.attempt: falsify crates/liminal-xtask/src/haq.rs:1 by checking whether verify_qualified_repo bails before reaching verify_packet_shape when the packet has no provenance, making the qualified path vacuous for unqualified packets
attempts.observed_result: verifier at crates/liminal-xtask/src/haq.rs:1 calls verify_packet_shape as its first check in verify_qualified_repo before any provenance check, and the test the_qualified_gate_refuses_a_packet_that_has_not_run confirms it refuses for the stated qualification_state reason, not by accident at a later check

attempts.attempt: falsify crates/liminal-query/src/lib.rs:1 by checking whether the incremental_paragraph_oracle calls paragraph::parse through a use-alias that the independence scan does not recognize
attempts.observed_result: verifier at crates/liminal-query/src/lib.rs:1 through verify_oracle_independence scans use_aliases for renamed forbidden symbols and adds both function and module alias forms to the watched list, so use liminal_source::paragraph::parse as p followed by p(input) is caught by the test an_aliased_production_call_in_an_oracle_is_refused

attempts.attempt: falsify crates/liminal-xtask/src/haq.rs:1 by checking whether the review record's integrity binding covers the structured attempts and findings claims, or whether editing an attempt under an intact binding is undetected
attempts.observed_result: verifier at crates/liminal-xtask/src/haq.rs:1 computes integrity_binding_sha256 over review_claims_sha256 which hashes the persisted attempts, findings and independently_reproduced arrays in canonical JSON, so editing an attempt under an intact binding is caught by the test the_integrity_binding_covers_the_structured_claims
